mostWorthwhile.text: Powering the atmospheric processor was most worthwhile: it connected the oxygen goal to a useful explanation of processing Martian carbon dioxide.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the array cable was sensible but relatively predictable compared with the later oxygen and radio developments.

surprise.text: The processor vents carbon monoxide while supplying oxygen, a detail that made the life-support system more concrete.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions I chose felt purposeless; the offered compatible options and stated goals made the sequence clear, though I did not discover compatibility myself.

continue.text: Yes. The practical repair details and the prospect of further developments after hearing from Earth would make me curious to continue.
